evidence.title: What's behind Russell and Mercedes' F1 engine penalty delay
evidence.body: [e001:f01] Early-season reliability problems mean both Russell and team-mate Kimi Antonelli have been forced to go over their in-season component allocation to get through to the end of the campaign. [e001:f02] Antonelli elected to take extra power unit components at the Italian GP last weekend, which meant he started down in 19th - although he still managed to win the race. [e001:f03] It had initially appeared likely that Russell would choose to take his at the next race in Azerbaijan, because the Baku circuit's long straights would allow him to make similar progress up the field. [e001:f04] However, it has emerged that Mercedes plans to hold fire on making the switch because it wants to coincide Russell's change with upgraded parts. [e001:f05] As The Race reported after the Italian GP, Mercedes is preparing an update to its power unit thanks to the extra allowance it has been granted under F1's Additional Development and Upgrade Opportunities (ADUO) system. [e001:f06] This move has added an extra layer of complication as to when Russell takes a new power unit because he is already at the limit of several of his components - so has no headroom for new parts without penalties. [e001:f07] Having maxed out his internal combustion engine, turbo, energy store (battery), and control electronics allowance for the season, a move to fresh components at the next couple of races would trigger penalties. [e001:f08] Speaking at the Spanish GP, Russell said that the plan now was to twin his engine penalty with the ADUO step as it was illogical to take a double penalty hit. [e001:f09] Asked if there were any regrets about not following Antonelli in taking a fresh engine for the Italian GP, Russell said: "We were always going to take my penalty with the ADUO upgrade. [e001:f10] So it makes zero sense for me." A final decision has not been taken by Mercedes yet about when its ADUO step will be introduced, although it had originally been anticipated that it could come for the next batch of flyaways in Azerbaijan, Malaysia, and Singapore. [e001:f11] However, sources suggest that the spec is now looking much more likely to appear for the triple-header in the United States, Mexico and Brazil that begins at Austin on October 23-25. [e001:f12] When Mercedes goes for that upgrade - which is understood to include an improved turbo - then Antonelli will also have access to it. [e001:f13] The championship leader did not go for a full power unit change in Italy, as Mercedes instead restricted the switch to his internal combustion engine, battery and control electronics. [e001:f14] That means he has freedom to take a new turbo, MGU-K, exhaust and ancillaries without penalty. [e001:f15] Any improvement in specification that the works Mercedes team introduces also has to be made available to customer teams, although only via a single unit for each customer at the first event. [e001:f16] Advertisement 00:00。

evidence.title: ホンダ、交通安全評価指標「FIA Road Safety Index」の製品・サービスの安全関連評価領域で世界初の5スター獲得
evidence.body: [e002:f01] 授賞式は9月に開催されたFIAフォーミュラ・ワン世界選手権のイタリアグランプリの会場モンツァ・サーキットで行なわた 本田技研工業は9月8日、FIAが定める企業・団体の交通安全への取り組みの評価指標「FIA Road Safety Index」の製品・サービスの安全関連評価において、世界で初めてとなる最高ランクの「5スター」を獲得したと発表した。 [e002:f02] FIA Road Safety Indexは、企業や団体の事業活動が交通安全に与える影響を可視化・評価する指標で、各企業や団体の交通安全目標の設定や経営トップの関与（コミットメント）、バリューチェーン全体における交通事故死傷者数（フットプリント）を推計・把握するプロセスなどをもとに、交通安全への取り組みを総合的に判断、評価するとともに、組織全体に安全文化を浸透させ、その継続的な改善につなげることを目的としたもの。 [e002:f03] またこの指標は、原材料調達から製品の開発・製造、ユーザーへ製品を届けるまでの、自社の企業活動を対象とする「サプライチェーン評価」と、製品やサービスを対象とする「製品・サービスの安全関連評価」の2つの領域で構成され、今回の5スター認定は後者におけるものとなる。 [e002:f04] ホンダが「FIA Road Safety Index」の5スターを獲得した FIA Road Safety Indexに関してホンダは、2025年2月に日本での取り組みを対象に、当時の最高ランクであった3スターを自動車業界で初めて獲得。 [e002:f05] その後、同指標の評価項目が拡充され、従来の「コミットメント」「フットプリント」に、「計画（プランニング）」「安全パフォーマンスのモニタリング」「安全文化マネジメントおよびサプライチェーン／製品・サービスの対象範囲」を加えた全5項目からなる評価体系が完成し、最高ランクが5スターへと拡大されていた。 [e002:f06] これを受けホンダは、今回の評価対象地域を、二輪車および四輪車それぞれでグローバル販売台数の90％以上をカバーする世界17か国に拡大し、総合的な審査を受けた結果、拡充された評価項目を含む、安全の取り組みのPDCAプロセス全体が高く評価され、最高ランクとなる5スターの認定にいたったという。 [e002:f07] ・経営トップの関与のもと、中長期戦略に基づき安全への取り組みを推進している点 ・グローバルで交通事故死傷者数をフットプリントとして推計・把握している点 ・安全目標に向けた進捗を、サステナビリティガバナンスの一環としてグローバルの安全会議にてモニタリングしている点 ・先進安全技術のグローバル展開と、組織的な安全文化の醸成を推進している点 ・交通安全に関する情報開示を積極的に実施している点 ホンダは、道を使う誰もが事故に遭わない社会の実現に向け、「Safety for Everyone」のグローバル安全スローガンのもと、2030年に全世界でホンダの二輪車・四輪車が関与する交通事故死者半減、2050年には交通事故死者ゼロという目標の達成を目指している。 [e002:f08] 企業との連携に加え、各国政府に対しても、FIA Road Safety Indexの評価手法を規制やコンプライアンスの枠組みに活用し、世界中の交通安全基準の向上につなげるよう働きかけています。 [e002:f09] その先頭に立ち、世界で初めて5スター評価を獲得したホンダに心より敬意を表します。 [e002:f10] FIA 自動車モビリティ・サステナビリティ・ツーリズム担当事務総長 ウィレム・グルーネワルド氏のコメント FIA Road Safety Indexを5スター評価へと拡充したことは、交通安全を企業の意思決定における測定可能で説明責任を伴う要素とするという私たちの目標に向けた重要な一歩です。 [e002:f11] 世界中の組織は、その事業活動、従業員、製品、サービス、サプライチェーンを通じて、交通安全に大きな影響を与えています。 [e002:f12] 今回の評価手法の拡充により、各組織は自らの影響をより幅広く把握できるだけでなく、目標の設定、進捗の測定、交通安全への取り組みの可視化、そして継続的な改善を行なうことが可能になります。 [e002:f13] ホンダが新たな5スター評価を世界で初めて獲得したことは、私たちが本指標を通じて促進したい高い志を体現するものです。 [e002:f14] 本田技研工業 安全運転普及本部事務局長 小嶋幹人氏のコメント このたび、ホンダの安全の取り組みが、最高ランクの5スターという評価をいただけたことを、大変意義深く受け止めています。 [e002:f15] 製品を使う1人ひとりと、その周囲の交通参加者の安全まで見据え、安全技術の進化、安全運転普及活動、事故実態の把握と改善を通じて、交通事故そのものを減らしていくことです。 [e002:f16] 企業の交通安全への取り組みを可視化するFIA Road Safety Indexは、私たち自身の現在地と、次に取り組むべき課題を示してくれました。

evidence.title: FIA President's F1 2026 calender update as major decision looms
evidence.body: [e003:f01] FIA President gives F1 2026 calendar update amid uncertainty Henry Valantine 10 Sep 2026 9:17 AM Mohammed Ben Sulayem has spoken about the F1 2026 calendar. [e003:f02] FIA President Mohammed Ben Sulayem has said the Formula 1 calendar “is not changing unless we have to”, with the FIA and Formula One Management in regular communication over the schedule. [e003:f03] FOM chief executive Stefano Domenicali said a decision over the calendar for the rest of the season would not be taken before mid-September, as conflict continues in the Middle East. [e003:f04] FIA President: ‘Business as usual’ for now; safety remains paramount The FIA, as Formula 1’s governing body, has to approve any calendar changes and with the Saudi Arabian Grand Prix having been cancelled and the Bahrain Grand Prix rescheduled with a move to Malaysia, there may yet be further changes. [e003:f05] The 2026 campaign is due to end with races in Qatar and Abu Dhabi, and Ben Sulayem insisted that people’s safety remains paramount in any decision-making. [e003:f06] While, for now, the calendar is “business as usual” and the sport is “not changing anything unless we have to”, the governing body and FOM will be taking advice on how situations develop locally. [e003:f07] “Being from that part of the world, we can’t jump the gun and just say, ‘that’s it, we are cancelling’ and then cancel,” Ben Sulayem told the Associated Press. [e003:f08] No, of course not. [e003:f09] But we’ll have also to listen to the governments and to the local promoter there.” Should either or both races need cancelling, Domenicali has already confirmed there is contingency for Formula 1 to end its season in Europe in December, with Imola touted as a potential host if required. [e003:f10] “I think human lives are more important than motorsport, and the wellbeing of my family being there and the UAE nationals and everyone that lives there comes as a priority.” With the 2027 calendar not yet having been announced either, Ben Sulayem confirmed that “for the time being, there is no emergency” with next season’s schedule. [e003:f11] The Qatar Grand Prix is due to take place from 27-29 November as it stands, with the Abu Dhabi Grand Prix provisionally scheduled to close out the season from 4-6 December. [e003:f12] Join our broadcast channel on WhatsApp to get the scoop on the latest developments from our team of accredited journalists. [e003:f13] Read next: Bernie Ecclestone denies arrest claims after ‘massive c*ck-up’。

Aston Martin signals confidence for Madring positivity after ‘good step’ at Monza
evidence.body: [e004:f01] Mike Krack believes Aston Martin has "confidence" in a positive performance at this weekend's Spanish Grand Prix after taking what he described as a "good step" at Monza last time out. [e004:f02] The Silverstone-based squad is firmly still in the phase of trial and error with its myriad of upgrades, both on car and engine, and last week's race at the Temple of Speed was always expected to be a tough weekend. [e004:f03] Having made Q2 in Hungary, Fernando Alonso made good work of the AMR26 to finish ninth in Zandvoort - the team's best result of the season. [e004:f04] But Monza's fast characteristics were always going to plague its work-in-progress Honda power unit, despite its ADUO-assisted upgrades. [e004:f05] But speaking to media, including Motorsport Week, at the Madring ahead of its inaugural Grand Prix, Krack spoke of the positives taken from Italy. [e004:f06] "Well, I'm happy with the step that has been taken in Monza," he said. [e004:f07] "And I said already before, your drivability is a big subject. [e004:f08] It's not only the engine, it's not only the chassis, it's really the combination of both. [e004:f09] "The downshift, the brakes, how is the tyre condition, what is the speed you have arrived, super clip, or whatever. [e004:f10] So, there's a lot of elements playing into this. [e004:f11] "But I'm really happy with the step we have taken together in Monza. [e004:f12] Now, the performance was not great in Monza, that is clear. [e004:f13] But for a track like this one here, it's good to have that, because it gives confidence, and confidence is the only way where you can attack when the walls are so close. [e004:f14] So, it's a good step. [e004:f15] "I think Orihara-san [Shintaro Orihara, his Honda counterpart] will agree with me, drivability is never good enough. [e004:f16] You always can improve, and we will continue working on that as we have done the whole season.

evidence.title: 【分析】角田裕毅、初開催マドリンク攻略のカギを語る。ホンダは燃焼対策に手応え、各ドライバーが明かした注目ポイントに迫る【スペインGP】｜Formula1 Report (Text by Yoshito)
evidence.body: [e001:f01] ホンダは燃焼対策に手応え、各ドライバーが明かした注目ポイントに迫る【スペインGP】 Formula1 Report (Text by Yoshito) 2026年9月11日 04:07 ◾️週末を前に 初開催となるマドリンクでの開催を前に2026シーズン第14戦スペインGPの週末とは異なるタイミングから多くのチームが動きを見せた。 [e001:f02] ◾️レーシングブルズ スペインGPを前に、木曜日のメディアデーでは今季3戦目の代役参戦となる角田裕毅が初開催となるマドリンクへの意気込みを語った。 [e001:f03] 直近の2戦では、ザントフォールトでトップ10に迫る走りを見せた後、モンツァではポイントを獲得するなど、徐々にパフォーマンスを取り戻している。 [e001:f04] ザントフォールトではポイント目前まで迫り、モンツァでは実際にポイントを獲得。 [e001:f05] さらに週末を通じてパフォーマンスを向上させていくことができたと振り返り、「この軌道を維持して、今週もできればポイントを獲得したい」と続けた。 [e001:f06] 2027年のシートを巡る戦いが続く中、初開催のマドリンクは、現在の流れをさらに強固なものにするための重要な週末となりそうだ。 [e001:f07] モンツァではトップ10入りを逃したことで「9戦連続にならなかったのは少し残念」としながらも、これまでの9戦で8度ポイントを獲得しており、カナダGPでスタートできなかったレースを除けば、非常に安定したルーキーシーズンを送っている。 [e001:f08] 長らくフェラーリとの接点が多くあるドライバーだがFDA出身では無く、フェラーリとの接点の始まりは2016年のサードドライバー就任だ。 [e001:f09] フェラーリはモンツァで使用されていたPUが再び使用できる状態であることを確認した上で、今週末には使用する可能性は無く1回目のADUOアップデートを受けたモデルを使用する予定だ。 [e001:f10] また今回の欠場発表時には「F1マシンのコックピットに戻れる状態では無い」と明言されており、これまでハジャーの欠場を際しての発表では「不必要なリスクを取らない」など軟化したコメントが中心であったことから、思った以上に怪我の回復などが芳しく無い可能性などが考えられる。 [e001:f11] また木曜日にはスペインGPを前に、マックス・フェルスタッペン及びリアム・ローソンの両者が初開催となるマドリンクへの展望を語った。 [e001:f12] 前戦イタリアGPではモンツァで表彰台を獲得したフェルスタッペンだが、マドリンクは高速かつ低ダウンフォースが求められたモンツァとは大きく異なるレイアウトとなる。 [e001:f13] それでも、現在のマシンの状態を考えれば、モンツァのようなサーキットで表彰台を獲得できたこと自体が非常に良い結果だったと振り返った。 [e001:f14] 「我々はその結果にとても満足している。 [e001:f15] まだマシンについて学んでいることも多いし、来年に向けて改善したい部分もたくさんある。 [e001:f16] それでも表彰台を獲得できるのは、いつだって歓迎すべきこと」と語り、2026年の戦いだけでなく、翌年を見据えたマシン開発にもつながる週末だったと説明した。

[e002:f04] The announcement came as Robin, who has raced successfully in Rotax and WSK karting series, was set to join Red Bull’s young driver programme from 2027 onwards. [e002:f05] Consistent coverage Where the coverage agrees All outlets agree on Robin Raikkonen joining Red Bull’s young driver programme from 2027. [e002:f06] Kimi Räikkönen, who retired from F1 at the end of the 2021 season, said: “We are all thrilled and excited that Robin has been chosen to further his racing path as a member of the Red Bull junior team.” Red Bull team principal Laurent Mekies described Robin as someone who “has already demonstrated exceptional ability in karting,” adding that his speed, racecraft and natural talent have made him “one of the most promising young drivers in his age group.” Mekies and Kimi on plan Mekies said Red Bull’s goal is to develop Robin “step by step, without placing any unnecessary pressure on his shoulders,” while also saying the team will give him “the time, support and resources he needs to maximise his potential.” In Kimi Räikkönen’s remarks, he credited Red Bull’s support during discussions and said the programme would provide “all the experience required to develop his natural talent.” RaceFans reported that Red Bull’s team principal Laurent Mekies called Robin “one of the most promising young drivers in his age group,” citing his “maturity, his calm approach and his clear focus on driving.” The Race added that Kimi said Robin would “dedicate all his efforts to warrant the trust that Red Bull is placing in him,” as the junior programme is set to be led by Gwen Lagrue when Robin joins next year. [e002:f07] What it means next With Robin set to officially start working with Red Bull from 2027, multiple outlets framed the move as a continuation of Red Bull’s junior pathway, which has included alumni such as Sebastian Vettel and Max Verstappen. [e002:f08] Infobae said the Oracle Red Bull Racing junior team has trained other champions such as Dutchman Max Verstappen or German Sebastian Vettel, and it quoted the team statement that Robin will join the driver development programme starting in 2027. [e002:f09] Le Soir reported that Red Bull Racing welcomed Robin Räikkönen to its development programme, describing him as “Aged 11” and reiterating that he is the son of Kimi Räikkönen (2007) and that he has recorded successes in national and international Rotax and WSK championships. [e002:f10] Explore the original reporting Compare all 18 sources How each outlet frames it Every outlet we compared, the headline it ran, and a link to the original article. [e002:f11] The young Finnish driver, who is still competing in karting, will be part of the energy team's driver academy starting in 2027. [e002:f12] Five years after Kimi’s retirement, world champion and absolute motorsport legend, Red Bull’s academy has announced the signing of his son Robin, only 11 years old, ahead of the upcoming season. [e002:f13] "The young Finn will become part of Red Bull's driver development program from 2027, which has helped guide numerous drivers on their path to Formula 1," the team responsible for debuts of drivers like Max Verstappen, Carlos Sainz, and Pierre Gasly stated in a release. [e002:f14] Robin Raikkonen is the son of Kimi Raikkonen, world champion in F1 in 2007, who accumulated 21 Grand Prix victories and 103 podiums over 19 seasons between 2001 and 2021, and who has already achieved success in national and international karting championships, Rotax and WSK. [e002:f15] Laurent Mekies, team principal and CEO of Red Bull Racing, highlighted that Raikkonen’s son "has already demonstrated exceptional ability in karting." "His speed, racecraft, and natural talent have established him as one of the most promising young drivers in his category," he said. evidence.title: How SpaceX IPO Illuminates Equity Investment Challenges
evidence.body: [e001:f01] It also sheds light on considerations that equity investors need to keep in view. [e001:f02] It’s understandable when a blockbuster firm such as SpaceX floats on the stock market and thousands of its staff become millionaires. iIt shows how certain investors appear to focus on the immediate drama. [e001:f03] The IPO of Elon Musk’s spacefaring business has undoubtedly been one of the stock market stories of 2026 and it may even have weakened the narrative of companies forsaking public markets for private ones instead. (See related commentary here. ) Beyond the headlines, there’s a long-term investment story at work. [e001:f04] Back in late June, Ron Baron, founder and CEO of his eponymous US-based firm, Baron Capital , said he thought that SpaceX could become the largest and most profitable company on the planet. [e001:f05] “Over the following 10 or 15 years, we think SpaceX could achieve a valuation of $10 trillion-plus,” he said. [e001:f06] Stephen Millar, head of Europe business development at Baron Capital, said SpaceX has “definitely highlighted characteristics that we look for in successful investments: competitive advantages in a growth industry and exceptional management.” A problem is that concentrating on large IPOs can “take a lot of attention away from other exceptional growth stories and investments,” he told WealthBriefing at a recent meeting in London. [e001:f07] The firm’s team employs fundamental research to identify and invest in companies with significant growth opportunities, durable competitive advantages, and strong management, at attractive valuations. [e001:f08] Baron Capital is a long-only investor in equities. [e001:f09] The firm takes an entirely bottom-up approach to investing. [e001:f10] “To preserve and grow purchasing power in that environment, investors need to own assets that appreciate at a faster rate. [e001:f11] Different perspectives Clients fall into three types: pension funds; endowments and sovereign wealth funds; private banks, advisors and family offices; and in the US, retail investors. [e001:f12] Millar's focus is on institutional investors and professional intermediaries. [e001:f13] “We have noticed in the last five to six years that the investment focus of short-term retail investors is getting shorter,” Millar said. [e001:f14] In addition, we believe the long-term potential of AI to increase productivity, strengthen businesses, and generate growth has been largely underestimated by investors.” Baron Capital’s various investment strategies hold firms that include those likely to be boosted by AI themes, or which have clear competitive advantages, including: Airbnb; Amazon; CBRE; Broadcom; CME Group; Cloudflare; Datadog; Digital Realty Trust; Eli Lilly; Equinix; FactSet; FIGS; Guardant; Heico; Interactive Brokers; JLL; Mastercard; Meta; Microsoft; Nvidia; RBC Bearings; Samsung; SpaceX; Spotify; TSMC; Tesla; Charles Schwab; Visa; and Waystar. [e001:f15] Beyond AI, Baron Capital’s investment team also sees opportunities in insurance, healthcare and entertainment, Millar said. evidence.body: [e003:f01] The launch was confirmed by spaceflight analyst Jonathan McDowell ( @planet4589 ), marking another completed mission for the U.S. [e003:f02] No further details about the classified payload's orbit or deployment status have been publicly released at this time. @planet4589: "LAUNCH at 1542 UTC Sep 10 of a Falcon 9 with the USSF-153 mission for US Space Force." — September 10, 2026, 22:02 UTC 📌 UPDATE — September 10, 2026 SpaceX has successfully launched the USSF-153 mission to orbit. [e003:f03] Liftoff occurred from Space Launch Complex 4E at Vandenberg Space Force Base in California on September 10, 2026. [e003:f04] SpaceX confirmed the successful orbital delivery via its official channels shortly after launch. [e003:f05] The mission marks another operational milestone for SpaceX's partnership with the U.S. [e003:f06] Space Force. @SpaceX · Sep 10, 2026 "Falcon 9 launches USSF-153 to orbit from pad 4E in California" 📌 UPDATE — September 10, 2026 SpaceX successfully launched the USSF-153 mission from SLC-4E at Vandenberg Space Force Base at 15:43 UTC today aboard Falcon 9 booster B1081, on its 27th flight. [e003:f07] Space Force payload has been delivered to orbit. 🚀 Liftoff confirmed — @SpaceX 🛬 Booster landing — @SpaceX SpaceX is in the final stretch of launch preparations for the USSF-153 mission, a classified payload for the U.S. [e003:f08] Space Force launching aboard a Falcon 9 Block 5 rocket from Vandenberg Space Force Base in California. [e003:f09] As of Thursday morning, the company confirmed all systems are nominal and weather conditions are sitting at 70% favorable — propellant loading was set to begin ahead of a three-hour launch window opening at 8:37 a.m. [e003:f10] Source: @SpaceX — September 10, 2026 The Mission USSF-153 is a classified mission contracted by the U.S. [e003:f11] The launch site is Space Launch Complex 4E (SLC-4E) at Vandenberg, SpaceX's primary West Coast pad and the standard staging ground for polar and sun-synchronous orbit missions serving national security customers. [e003:f12] Its resume includes Crew-7, CRS-29, the PACE Earth-science mission, and 16 Starlink launches — a track record that reflects how thoroughly SpaceX has normalized rapid booster reuse for both commercial and government work. [e003:f13] Mission Count Context According to , USSF-153 marks the 104th Falcon 9 mission of 2026 — a pace that underscores how routine high-cadence orbital launches have become for SpaceX. [e003:f14] The company has maintained a launch tempo that would have seemed extraordinary just a few years ago, and national security missions like this one now slot into that schedule alongside commercial Starlink and rideshare flights with little fanfare. [e001:f15] He is frequently consulted on innovations in passenger experience by airlines and technology providers. evidence.title: ファーマコビジランス向けAI製品「Veeva Falcon Safety」発表 Veeva
evidence.body: [e002:f01] 同製品は、有害事象のインテイク、症例処理、およびフォローアップを効率化することで、コスト削減、対応スピードの向上、ならびにコンプライアンスの維持を実現するもの。 [e002:f02] Falcon Safety は Veeva Safety とのシームレスな連携に加え、Oracle Argus や ArisGlobal LifeSphere MultiVigilance を含むすべての E2B 準拠セーフティシステムにおいて、インテイクおよびフォローアップの管理を可能にする。 [e002:f03] Falcon Safetyは2026年11月にアーリーアダプター向けに提供開始予定で、ライフサイエンス業界に特化した Veeva の AI ソリューション「Veeva AI 」の一部である。 [e002:f04] Veeva は、アプリケーション、エージェント、データ、コンサルティングを通じて、ライフサイエンス業界に特化したクラウドサービスを提供している。 [e002:f05] イノベーション、優れた製品、顧客の成功に尽力し、世界最大のバイオ医薬品企業から新興バイオテクノロジー企業まで、1500 社以上にサービスを提供している。 [e002:f06] また、パブリック・ベネフィット・コーポレーション企業として、顧客や従業員、株主、サービスを提供する業界を含む、すべてのステークホルダーの利益バランスを保つことに取り組んでいる。 [e002:f07] ◆Marius Mortensen Veeva Falcon製品担当バイスプレジデントのコメント 我々は、Veeva Safety の構築にあたり、グローバルの症例処理担当者、医薬品安全性情報管理（ファーマコビジランス）エキスパート、そしてセーフティスペシャリストの方々と緊密に連携する機会に恵まれた。 [e002:f08] Falcon Safety を通じて、そのパートナーシップをさらに強固なものとし、業界におけるセーフティオペレーションの再定義を支援できることを嬉しく思う。

previous_updates.title: SpaceX、Vandenbergで2026年50回目の打ち上げ
previous_updates.summary: Vandenbergでは7月1日と10日にもFalcon 9によるStarlink打ち上げが行われ、7月21日の飛行がカリフォルニア州で2026年50回目の打ち上げとなった。 別のStarlinkミッションはエンジン点火後に直前中止となったが、SpaceXは機体とペイロードが安全だと説明した。 当初の離昇予定は米東部時間7時49分だった。
